Uses of Package
javax.microedition.theme

Classes in javax.microedition.theme used by javax.microedition.theme
Element
          Represents a customizable element in an appearance.
ElementException
          This is a superclass for exceptions thrown when there is an error that involves a customizable element.
ElementNotFoundException
          Thrown to indicate that an element was not found in a theme or skin.
MediaObject
          Represents the media object content of an element.
ModifyNotSupportedException
          Thrown when a modify operation is attempted and the implementation does not support modify operations.
Skin
          Represents a skin, a collection of customization data specific to an application.
SkinException
          Thrown by SkinManager methods or updateApplicationElement in Skin if a skin-related operation fails.
SkinListener
          Listener interface for applications interested in skin related events in the system.
SkinManager
          Manages skins of some application in the device.
SkinNotFoundException
          Thrown by SkinManager when a skin is not found upon retrieval.
Theme
          Represents a system wide user interface theme.
ThemeException
          Thrown when there is an error condition related to a theme.
ThemeListener
          Listener interface for applications interested in theme related events in the system.
ThemeManager
          Provides applications access to themes installed in the device or in the application's JAR file.
ThemeMetadata
          Stores the metadata associated with an appearance.
ThemeNotFoundException
          Thrown when a theme is not found when retrieving, changing or deleting a theme.
